overview: Close the highest-value chat gap between the web chunter/chat experience and the Expo mobile app by adding channel settings, members, pinned messages, thread correctness, history navigation, typing indicators, and basic channel administration.

scopeCuts: Focus on chat parity inside mobile chat routes, hooks, store, repository, and realtime rules
Exclude workbench-only side panels, inline comments, and mail/notifier presentation surfaces

prerequisites: Scaffold, auth, API client, and current chat phases are already implemented in mobile/
mobile-attachments should be complete before attachment-heavy channel/thread parity is called done
mobile-websocket should be complete before typing-indicator parity is called done
nonGoals: Recreating every Svelte side panel from workbench chat
Rewriting the chat domain away from the current repository/query/store architecture
Delivering new server-side chat models beyond what mobile already consumes
contracts: Server state remains in TanStack Query; ephemeral draft/unread/typing state remains in Zustand
New chat routes stay under mobile/src/app/(app)/chat/**
Thread and channel timelines must not diverge on message identity, reaction ownership, or cache keys
If typing infrastructure is unavailable, the UI degrades cleanly without broken polling loops

tasks.title: Expand chat repository parity contract
tasks.description: Add repository methods for channel detail, members, pinned messages, channel updates, DM conversion, history search/jump, and thread-message correctness.
acceptanceCriteria: Repository exposes typed methods for channel detail, members, pinned messages, channel update, DM conversion, and message-history search.
Thread fetch/send paths distinguish parent timeline messages from thread replies.
Removed or inaccessible channels return typed empty/failure states instead of crashing dependent screens.

tasks.title: Extend chat hooks for parity queries and mutations
tasks.description: Wire the expanded repository contract into TanStack Query so channel settings, pins, history search, and thread correctness all share the same cache model.
acceptanceCriteria: Hooks expose channel-detail, pinned-message, and history-search queries without screens calling repositories directly.
Pin/unpin, channel-update, DM-conversion, and thread-reaction mutations invalidate the exact channel or thread keys they affect.
Thread reaction and reply mutations update both active thread and parent channel caches consistently.

tasks.title: Fix chat store and unread/typing parity state
tasks.description: Expand chat client state so unread, active thread, typing participants, and draft attachment state are consistent across channel and thread views.
acceptanceCriteria: Unread sync uses the correct account identity and rebuilds unread state from fresh server contexts.
Active thread/channel state prevents self-generated replies from incrementing unread counts for the currently-open conversation.
Typing and draft attachment state clear on route teardown and workspace switch.

tasks.title: Add channel header and settings surfaces
tasks.description: Add a first-class channel settings route so mobile users can inspect and edit channel metadata the way web users can.
acceptanceCriteria: Channel screen header exposes navigation into a typed settings route.
Settings route supports channel name, description, privacy, and basic metadata display/edit.
Channels removed or made inaccessible while settings are open render a recoverable error state.

tasks.title: Add channel members and DM conversion flow
tasks.description: Bring member visibility and DM-to-private-channel conversion to mobile so channel collaboration flows match web behavior more closely.
acceptanceCriteria: Mobile exposes a members route from channel settings with readable participant rows and empty/error states.
DM surfaces expose a conversion path to private channel only when the repository reports the action is valid.
Failed member fetches or conversion attempts do not leave the channel list in a stale optimistic state.

tasks.title: Add pinned messages parity
tasks.description: Bring pin/unpin and pinned-message browsing to mobile so important channel context is available outside the live timeline.
acceptanceCriteria: Message surfaces expose pin/unpin affordances and channel settings route exposes pinned-message browsing.
Pinned list renders stable previews that navigate back to the underlying message or thread context.
Removing a pin updates the pinned list and source timeline without requiring a full channel refetch.

tasks.title: Bring thread flow to parity-correctness
tasks.description: Correct the thread model and screen behavior so thread replies, reactions, and attachments behave like a real thread surface instead of a channel-side variant.
acceptanceCriteria: Thread screen reads and mutates thread-specific cache keys, including reactions and reply inserts.
Reply creation uses the correct thread semantics so replies do not leak back into the main channel timeline.
Thread attachment and reaction actions update the active thread view immediately and recover cleanly on failure.

tasks.title: Add channel history search and jump-to-date
tasks.description: Expose history navigation beyond infinite scroll so mobile users can find older conversation context like they can on web.
acceptanceCriteria: Channel routes expose searchable message history by text and date without collapsing the main message list state.
Jump-to-date loads the nearest history window and lands the user on a stable anchor message.
When the requested history window has no results, the UI reports that explicitly instead of silently resetting to newest messages.

tasks.title: Add channel create/edit surfaces
tasks.description: Bring mobile up to basic channel administration parity so users can create channels and edit existing channel metadata without leaving mobile.
acceptanceCriteria: Mobile exposes typed routes for creating a channel and editing an existing channel.
Channel form supports name, description, privacy, and member selection with validation.
Save failures keep the form open with recoverable field or transport errors.

tasks.title: Add typing indicator parity
tasks.description: Use the websocket/realtime layer to show typing participants in channel view without introducing unstable polling loops.
acceptanceCriteria: Channel view renders typing participants only for the active conversation and clears them on navigation away.
Typing state degrades cleanly when websocket connectivity is unavailable.
Typing updates do not trigger full timeline refetches or duplicate unread-count changes.

failureModes.failure: Thread reaction updates the wrong cache
failureModes.detection: Reaction changes do not appear in the open thread
failureModes.recovery: Invalidate and patch the thread cache directly, not only the channel cache

failureModes.failure: DM conversion succeeds server-side but list stays stale
failureModes.detection: Converted conversation remains rendered as a DM
failureModes.recovery: Invalidate DM and channel list keys together after conversion

failureModes.detection: Typing names remain visible after navigation
failureModes.recovery: Clear typing state on active-channel change and route teardown

failureModes.failure: History search returns ids without stable anchor context
failureModes.detection: Jump opens the wrong part of the conversation
failureModes.recovery: Carry anchor metadata and refetch the surrounding history window before navigation

failureModes.detection: Pin state differs between pins screen and message bubble
failureModes.recovery: Treat pin/unpin as a shared mutation contract with one invalidation owner

testCoverageMap: TASK-002: query invalidation and channel/thread cache consistency
TASK-003: unread identity, active-thread guard, and teardown cleanup
TASK-004: channel settings load/save + inaccessible-channel fallback
TASK-005: members route success + DM conversion failure rollback
TASK-006: pin/unpin optimistic flow + timeline/pins consistency
TASK-007: thread reply/reaction correctness + no-leak-to-channel invariant
TASK-008: history search empty-result and jump-anchor behavior
TASK-009: channel form validation + save failure retention
TASK-010: typing indicator realtime success + offline degradation
